meta_description: AI-Based Perishable Produce Transportation Optimizer for intelligent agricultural logistics, speed advisories, and live turn-by-turn navigation

landing.headline: AI-Powered Road Transport Optimization for Perishable Produce
landing.subheadline: Find the economically optimal route minimizing transit time, transport costs, and crop spoilage losses on real road networks with speed advisories and live navigation.

features.routes_desc: Computes multi-candidate routes on real road networks with live or estimated traffic, recommended speed limits per corridor stretch, and off-route recalculation.
features.trucks_desc: Calculates fleet requirements, per-truck capacity utilization, and printable load sheets automatically based on harvest weight.
features.spoilage_desc: Integrates crop-specific exponential decay models to balance transport costs against produce decay risk.
